QUOTE: With assembly (`MBEDTLS_CT_ASM`), it is `asm volatile("" : [x] "+r"(x))`. The empty asm claims to read and write the register, so the compiler cannot fold or prove anything about it.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the empty asm volatile with a "+r" input-output operand and explains it serves only to stop the optimiser from reasoning about the value.
